companySize.note: From data/original/salaries.csv (aijobs.net, 151,445 rows, downloaded 2026-11-07), US residents, titles mapped via each family's 10 role titles. company_size is 'M' for ~98% of US rows, so S/M/L carries almost no signal; employmentType and byRemote are usable. This CSV is a newer, larger snapshot than the one story.json was built from (e.g. DS 2024 = 14,828 vs 6,374), so counts are NOT comparable to story.json.
